messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "may sprinkle medicine into spoonful of applesauce"
set: ["may sprinkle medicine into spoonful of applesauce", "medicine may be sprinkled into small amount of applesauce", "sprinkle the contents onto a tablespoon of applesauce", "do not sprinkle contents on foods other than applesauce", "Eliquis Sprinkle", "Kapspargo Sprinkle", "Ezallor Sprinkle", "Drizalma Sprinkle", "Kapspargo Sprinkle capsules", "do not transfer leftover medicine into syringe", "another person may inject into the back of the upper arm", "may be injected into thigh or abdomen or have another person inject into back of upper arm", "misuse of medicine", "doctor may stop the medicine", "applesauce should not be warm", "different medicine may be an option"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
